blocks.text: ILIGAN CITY – In the run-up to All Souls’ Day here, business is brisk for merchants flowers and candles, two of the most common items Filipinos bring when visiting cemeteries during the annual observance. At the Alimyon Festival in Barangay Poblacion, flower vendors gather in stalls provided by the local government, creating a central marketplace for people buying flowers for their departed relatives. The festival runs from Oct. 30 to Nov. 3, near the Roman Catholic Cemetery, Chinese Cemetery and city-managed public cemetery in Barangay Villaverde.
